findings.title: Add-only rewrite leaves the DB out of step with the Drizzle schema; app writes ciphertext into the plaintext column
findings.label: match
findings.note: The add-only rewrite leaves the TS schema and snapshot declaring the source column encrypted, so they diverge from the DB.

findings.title: `stash init` (Drizzle) misreports a fail-closed sweep as a drizzle-kit failure and says EQL is not installed
findings.label: valid
findings.note: init's Drizzle path swallows the sweep CliExit, which leads index.ts to report 'EQL NOT installed' with wrong advice.

findings.title: Shipped stash-drizzle skill still describes the swept repair as data-destroying and sends users to a staged flow that collides with it
findings.label: valid
findings.note: skills/stash-drizzle/SKILL.md:64 still calls the repair data-destroying and wasn't updated, while stash-cli's skill was.

findings.title: Projects with historical unplaceable ALTERs can no longer complete `stash eql migration --drizzle` or the wizard
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Every skip now causes a CliExit(1) or wizard throw on every run, and there is no way to acknowledge a reviewed statement.

case_note: KD-2 found; KD-1 and KD-3 missed.
